_about: M15 automated defense: the numbers for hoppers, turret parts, sensors and their actions, floodlights, noisemakers, traps, the repair station, the base log and the radio. Pieces themselves (cost, hp, size, watts, turret damage/range/interval/loudness) are in buildables.json.

quiet.name: Quiet mode
quiet.about: Switches off every machine and generator on this sensor's power network until it clears, plus 30 s

floodlights.name: Floodlights
floodlights.about: Turns on every floodlight within 20 m (they only light at night; zombies see you further in the light)

decoy.name: Decoy
decoy.about: Sets off every charged noisemaker within 60 m, so the dead go there instead

lock_doors.name: Lock doors
lock_doors.about: Closes every door within 12 m and keeps them shut while it's triggered

machines_off.name: Machines off
machines_off.about: Switches off every machine on this sensor's power network while it's on; generators keep running for lights, fences and turrets
